import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(29500+ws)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W = torch.randn(8, 16); x = torch.randn(3, 16, requires_grad=True)
    ref = torch.nn.Linear(16, 8); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
    y_ref = ref(x); y_ref.sum().backward(); gx_ref = x.grad.clone()
    for cls, sl in [(ColumnParallelLinear, lambda g: g.chunk(ws,0)[rank]), (RowParallelLinear, lambda g: g.chunk(ws,1)[rank])]:
        ref.zero_grad(); x.grad=None
        y_ref = ref(x); y_ref.sum().backward()
        m = cls(16, 8, True, W); x.grad=None
        y = m(x); y.sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(y, y_ref, atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, sl(ref.weight.grad), atol=1e-5)
        bg = ref.bias.grad.chunk(ws)[rank] if cls is ColumnParallelLinear else ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, bg, atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(x.grad, gx_ref, atol=1e-5)
    if rank==0: print('ok', ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for ws in [1,2,4]: mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
